verdict.rationale: Groq's own platform goes beyond text chat. The Responses API documents image inputs (vision), and the official TypeScript SDK shows audio transcription with a Whisper model, both reachable through the same API. Evidence for each is a single brief mention, and image generation is not evidenced. missing for 10: image-generation models, dedicated vision/audio model documentation (supported models, limits), text-to-speech or other audio output, independent or hands-on corroboration of multimodal calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: The Responses API supports both text and image inputs while producing text outputs
